module_summary: 4-bit carry-lookahead adder block: per-bit propagate/generate feed a CLA unit producing carries for four 1-bit adders, plus group Pm/Gm outputs.

anchors.name: x
anchors.why: 4-bit operand A, feeds bit adders and propagate/generate logic.

anchors.name: y
anchors.why: 4-bit operand B, feeds bit adders and propagate/generate logic.

anchors.name: F
anchors.why: 4-bit sum output assembled from the four bit-adder results.

anchors.name: c0
anchors.why: Carry-in to first bit adder and the CLA unit.

anchors.name: c4
anchors.why: Carry-out computed by the CLA unit.

anchors.name: p1
anchors.why: Representative per-bit propagate signal x^y driving the CLA unit and Pm.

anchors.name: g1
anchors.why: Representative per-bit generate signal x&y driving the CLA unit and Gm.

anchors.name: c1
anchors.why: Representative lookahead carry from CLA into the next bit adder.

anchors.name: Pm
anchors.why: Group propagate output, AND of p1..p4 for higher-level lookahead.

anchors.name: Gm
anchors.why: Group generate output from g/p terms for higher-level lookahead.

groups.name: bit_adders
groups.description: Four 1-bit full adders producing sum bits F from x, y and carries.

groups.name: carry_lookahead
groups.description: CLA unit computing carries c1..c4 from p/g and c0.

groups.name: group_pg
groups.description: Group propagate/generate outputs for cascading into larger CLA.
